description: This file contains Makefile definitions for device configuration and build procedures related to the Microchip SAMA7G5-EK and associated NAND/Sdcard images, including build rules, device parameters, and external command invocations.

methods.name: define Device/default-nand
methods.description: Defines NAND device parameters such as block size, page size, and MKUBIFS options.

methods.name: define Build/at91-sdcard
methods.description: Build rule for creating an SD card image for the at91 target, handling filesystem formatting and copying boot files.

methods.name: define Device/microchip_sama7g5-ek
methods.description: Defines device-specific parameters for the Microchip SAMA7G5-EK evaluation board, including device tree and supported devices.
